name: Eraaya Lifespaces Ltd (rebranding to Ebix Ltd)
tagline: A former real-estate micro-cap that acquired the distressed US Ebix Inc., is now under SEBI scrutiny for possible cheating / stock manipulation, has had independent directors resign citing fraud, negative net worth optics and revenue down ~93% - uninvestable.
business_overview: Formerly a small real-estate / 'lifespaces' company; acquired Ebix Inc. and its global subsidiaries (US insurance/finance/travel software) in 2024 and is rebranding to Ebix Limited with a ~Rs 425 Cr fundraise. Seeded as an external lead from X triage (@BeatTheStreet10, untrusted) - itself a BEAR call: BTS warned at the all-time high when it was a crowd-favourite multibagger; the stock is since down >95%.
